main.welcome.card_title: Install the Golan Browser Extension (takes one minute)
main.welcome.cardTitle: Install the Golan Browser Extension (takes one minute)
main.welcome.step1: Open your browser's extensions page using the button below.
main.welcome.step2: Enable "Developer mode" at the top of the page.
main.welcome.step3: Click "Load unpacked" and select the extension folder (open it via the button below).
main.welcome.step4: Pin Golan's icon to the toolbar. Done! Downloads will now be captured by Golan, with a download button above every video.
main.welcome.tip: Tip: Copy any download link and Golan will capture it automatically. You can reopen this guide anytime from Options → Browsers.
